vulnerability: Extremely vulnerable to root desiccation if dry spell occurs within 10 days of emergence
action_rule: Sow only after soil receives >75 mm cumulative rainfall and 10-day break risk is <25%

vulnerability: Requires uniform topsoil moisture for hypocotyl elongation
action_rule: Adopt seed treatment with Trichoderma; intercrop with pigeon pea to buffer erratic dry breaks

vulnerability: Nursery seedlings damaged by either acute moisture deficit or premature submergence
action_rule: Align nursery sowing 21 days prior to predicted sustained monsoon surge date
